excelv.subTitle:
A combination laser that resolves a range of
skin concerns with three treatment modes
excelv.introDescription:
From vascular issues like facial redness and telangiectasia
to melasma, blemishes, and elasticity all at once,
the Excel V laser addresses complex skin concerns.

principles.title: What is the Excel V laser?
principles.content:
Excel V is a multi-solution device that uses three wavelengths and modes: 532nm KTP, 1064nm Nd:YAG, and Genesis microsecond mode.
It precisely targets complex skin issues that were difficult to treat with a single wavelength, matching each lesion's depth and type.

principles.title: Why it excels at treating vessels and redness
principles.content:
It can select the optimal wavelength for each type of vascular lesion, from surface redness in the epidermis to deeper blue vessels in the dermis.
A sapphire cooling system also protects the skin surface and reduces pain during treatment, allowing even sensitive, red skin to be treated comfortably.

principles.title: RE:BERRY's principle for Excel V treatment
principles.content:
Redness and pigmented lesions require improvement of the dermal environment, not just surface-level treatment.
RE:BERRY precisely diagnoses the depth and extent of lesions through 3D analysis, and restores a clear, healthy skin tone without damaging the skin barrier by adjusting wavelength and energy to each condition.

ulthera.subTitle:
The original lifting laser that tightens
deep skin layers with ultrasound energy
ulthera.introDescription:
When facial lines begin to sag with age
and elasticity starts to decline,
Ulthera is the lifting laser most people
think of first among dermatology lifting treatments.

principles.title: What is Ulthera?
principles.content:
Ultherapy Prime is a lifting treatment that uses high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) to deliver energy down to the SMAS layer beneath the skin.
Rather than the surface, it stimulates the skin's structural foundation with ultrasound to tighten the muscle layer. It lifts sagging skin and promotes collagen and elastin production, naturally improving facial elasticity.

principles.title: Why Ulthera is effective for skin elasticity
principles.content:
Ulthera precisely delivers 65–70°C ultrasound thermal energy to the SMAS layer, inducing tissue contraction and a regenerative response.
Through this process, loosened skin structure tightens again, and elasticity gradually recovers over time.
The key is that it's a lifting treatment that improves the skin structure itself, rather than temporarily pulling the skin.
Because Ulthera's thermal stimulation acts on the SMAS layer that supports the skin, it can deliver energy selectively without damaging the skin surface.

principles.title: RE:BERRY's principle for Ulthera treatment
principles.content:
Since skin sagging results from multiple factors working together — skin thickness, elastic structure, and fat distribution —
an accurate diagnosis of the current skin condition is needed first.
Also, rather than expecting results from a single session,
it's important to plan treatment considering the skin's recovery process as collagen regeneration progresses.
RE:BERRY avoids excessive energy use or unnecessary repeat treatments, and follows the principle of designing treatment tailored to skin condition and improvement goals.

gold-ptt.subTitle:
Specially engineered gold particles that
destroy the root cause of acne
gold-ptt.introDescription:
For recurring acne and increasing sebum production,
this is a targeted treatment that combines gold
micro-particles with a laser to selectively destroy
sebaceous glands and acne-causing bacteria.

principles.title: What is Gold PTT?
principles.content:
This treatment infuses specially coated microscopic gold particles deep into the sebaceous glands and acne bacteria, then irradiates a specific laser wavelength.
The gold particles absorb the laser light and generate localized heat, destroying the sebaceous glands that are the root cause of acne and eliminating the bacteria.

principles.title: Why it's effective for recurring acne
principles.content:
Rather than surface exfoliation or temporary inflammation relief, it lowers the activity of the sebaceous glands themselves that cause acne, significantly reducing the recurrence rate.
Because it acts only on the targeted area while minimizing damage to surrounding healthy skin, it reduces side effects such as dryness or redness after treatment.

principles.title: RE:BERRY's principle for Gold PTT treatment
principles.content:
This is not simply applying a solution and irradiating a laser.
RE:BERRY combines pre-treatment scaling and ultrasound infusion care to ensure the gold particles are sufficiently absorbed into the pores. We aim for customized treatment, adjusting laser intensity and frequency to each person's sebum production and skin sensitivity.
